name: Pillow
instruction: How does resting your head on a pillow make you feel? Create a 3D model of a pillow that captures the sense of relaxation and comfort.

Shape accuracy: The pillow has a rectangular shape.
The edges of the pillow are rounded for comfort.
The pillow has a slightly raised center.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The dimensions of the pillow are appropriate for resting one's head, typically around 50cm x 30cm.
Proportion: The proportion set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Texture and surface detail: The surface of the pillow appears plush and inviting.
The fabric texture suggests a soft, cozy material, like cotton or microfiber.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The pillow is positioned at a slight angle to suggest usability.
The pillow's thickness is consistent throughout to imply comfort.
Object distance and contact: The pillow is shown resting on a flat surface, indicating readiness for use.
There is no overlap with other objects, emphasizing its standalone comfort.

Instruction execution accuracy: The model captures the essence of relaxation and comfort through its design elements.
All specified attributes related to comfort and relaxation are accurately represented.
